scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,pwa -c blue,green "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w pwa"
scripts.dev-built: concurrently -n api,pwa -c blue,green "npm run start -w api" "npm run preview -w pwa"
scripts.test: npm run test:run -w api && npm run test:run -w pwa
scripts.test:watch: npm run test -w api && npm run test -w pwa
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w api && npm run test:coverage -w pwa
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check -w api && npm run type-check -w pwa
